name: Motrix
description: Retained source supports the recorded narrow C primary-app classification and separately documents a stronger signed builtin-plugin channel. Primary app update interaction is user-mediated and release verification relies on electron-updater/build configuration outside the inspected application code; builtin plugin hot updates use a pinned Ed25519 key.
limitations: The checkout does not prove release-time OS code-signing certificates or artifact signatures.
The plugin signature path is a separate channel and does not upgrade the primary app tier.
